messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: metering-agg-service elevated error rate (50% 5xx) and token-aggregate delta > 30% vs last hour. Keyspace mismatch observed between Redis checkpoint and S3 aggregates. Root ts=2008123456.
oncall-eric: Saw it. Jumping in. Any customer-visible alerts yet?
sre-jamie: Not seeing platform-wide 5xx from API, just the metering-agg workers. Checking worker logs now.
eng-ml-chen: I just deployed a serializer change to token-keys yesterday morning (rolling canary to 30%). Could be related — it changes the prefix format in Redis.
ops-bot: sample error excerpt:
```
ERROR metering.agg.worker: missing checkpoint for key token_win:acct:12345:2026-03-15T10 -- lookup returned nil
WARN metering.agg.kv: key prefix mismatch expected 'tk:' found 'token_win:'
```

oncall-eric: If serializer change is incompatible with older worker versions that read Redis, that would explain the mismatch. Priority: stop further mis-aggregations, prevent billing alerts, and assess customer impact.
sre-jamie: Action plan: (1) pause downstream overage-notifications, (2) flip aggregator to S3-fallback mode, (3) roll back serializer canary to previous container image, (4) restart aggregator workers. I'll own steps 1-3.
billing-maya: Please pause any automated overage emails and alerting. Finance: hold bill runs for windows affected in the last 2 hours. Tag any accounts with provisional credit flag.
support-alex: Copying customer ops playbook. I'll prepare a canned message for affected accounts after we confirm which accounts flagged. Need ETA on rollback.
eng-ml-chen: Rolling back canary now. Command:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/metering-agg metering-agg=ghcr.io/redwood/metering-agg:2026.03.12
```
Backing out the serializer change should revert key prefix.
sre-jamie: Flipped aggregator to fallback mode (S3 raw->recompute). This will add latency but preserve correctness. Command used:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/config -d '{"metering.fallback":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'
```
Restarting 6 workers now.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: Restarted metering-agg workers (6/6) -> healthy.
oncall-eric: Quick recon query against S3 raw to estimate backlog size:
```
SELECT account_id, sum(tokens) as s_tokens FROM raw_metering.events
WHERE event_time > now() - interval '3 hours' GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY s_tokens DESC LIMIT 20;
```
Initial run shows ~2.2M tokens pending reconciliation, ~0.8% of hourly traffic.
billing-maya: 0.8% is small, but some large customers might be affected. Please produce a list of accounts that had overage flags triggered in the last 60m.
sre-jamie: Running alarm query on alerting index... results: 7 unique accounts had transient overage flags (IDs: acct_42, acct_88, acct_129, acct_201, acct_305, acct_411, acct_999). Adding provisional 'billing-hold' tag and notifying Finance.
support-alex: Draft to customers ready, will only send after confirmation: "We detected an internal metering mismatch affecting usage reporting; your billing has not been finalized and we are withholding any overage charges while we reconcile. We'll follow up within 24 hours." OK? :thumbsup:
eng-ml-chen: After rollback finish, I'll run a compatibility check to ensure key prefixes in Redis match the expected pattern:
```
redis-cli --scan --pattern 'tk:*' | head -n 50
```
If old keys remain, we will run a migration script to rename prefixes.
ops-bot: migration job queued: job id metering-rekey-2008. Started recon job to recompute aggregates from S3 for affected windows.
sre-jamie: Status update: rollback completed at ts=2008123570, workers back to reading 'tk:' prefix. Recompute job started; expected finish in ~45 minutes. No new overage alerts since rollback.
oncall-eric: Handoff: I'm going offline in 25m. SRE handoff to jamie, please own monitoring until recompute completes.
sre-jamie: Taking over. I'll keep thresholds relaxed for a bit to avoid noisy paging, and coordinate with billing/support for customer comms.
billing-maya: Finance confirms no charges applied yet for the affected windows. They will apply provisional credits if any invoice was pre-generated.
support-alex: I'll queue the 7 accounts for proactive outreach once we have final reconciled numbers.
eng-ml-chen: Root cause hypothesis: serializer change altered Redis key prefix without a consumers-side guard — older workers saw unknown keys and emitted zero aggregates for those windows. RCA ticket being opened.
sre-jamie: Incident mitigated -> immediate customer impact contained: no invoices charged; overage flags suppressed; recompute job in progress. Next steps: RCA, migration/compatibility test added to deploy checklist, add feature-flag around key-format change, and a reconciliation monitor for keyspace drift. Opening follow-up ticket INC-2026-RCA.
oncall-eric: Thanks team. If anything flares during recompute, ping pager. Otherwise we'll post a final incident summary to #incidents and the postmortems channel.
sre-jamie: Final note: triage doc + action items attached to INC-2026. Assigning owners: eng-ml-chen (fix + tests), sre-jamie (monitor + migration script), billing-maya (billing safeguards), support-alex (customer comms). Closing live thread at ts=2008123678.
